name: Sparse separator, two consecutive aliases (A, A, B, B): the founder key with memory_fan_in 4 and 2 against the dense founder
credit: Will Glynn, cadence-teachers EXP-56, EXP-57, EXP-59 and EXP-60 (https://github.com/WGlynn/cadence-teachers): the chain seen three ways after the ambiguous chain Huncho reported on the Stone Age world, the hold rule, the reading in sequence, the boundary of the rule; the queued EXP-63 proposed the outcome gate; the consecutive-alias topology is Huncho's Stone Age V7.4 (https://github.com/ali12mahmood12345-boop/cadence-stone-age/blob/main/docs/V7_RESULTS.md)
question: With Brain.compose(..., memory_choice=True) and the founder key (the observation): do the place and ctx5 arms of the context-key screen keep their clean greedy passes, sampled success and first-try accuracy when the episodic memory's pattern separator is sparse (memory_fan_in 4 or 2) instead of dense?
scope: component: the episodic memory's pattern separator in V5's four-stage chain seen with two consecutive aliases (A, A, B, B); the brain, chamber, founders, signals and readings of the context-key screen
fan_in_note: The setting in question is memory_fan_in=16 against the dense founder. These witnesses have 7 inputs and 5 actions, so the place key has 7 neurons and the context key 12, and the library refuses a fan-in above a key's width; a code neuron cannot read 16 of 7. The reading tests the sparse separator on these keys at two declared fan-ins below their width, 4 and 2, each against the dense founder. A fan-in of 16 reads 0.1% of 12,824 inputs; neither arm reaches that sparsity, and the separation-quality evidence covers wide keys.

world.note: A, A, B, B: Huncho's Stone Age V7.4 topology with the hidden view's A and B; the right first and third actions change nothing seen, so only the brain's own correct actions tell stage 2 from stage 1 and stage 4 from stage 3

sensory.note: the dense founder: the observation keys the records, memory_fan_in 0; reading 2's sensory recipe, its lives reused (see analysis.control)

sparse4.note: the same with memory_fan_in=4: each of the 1,024 code neurons reads 4 of the place key's 7 sensory neurons and 4 of the context key's 12

sparse2.note: the same with memory_fan_in=2: 2 of 7 and 2 of 12

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: natural: none; corrective: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window (V5's corrective teacher)

evaluation.note: a frozen copy read at the arm's seam under its own rule: 100 sampled episodes from a reset each, the reading in sequence (first try per stage, retries), and one greedy episode (a clean pass: four stages in four decisions)

seeds.note: reading 2's 48 founders (202001 to 202048), reused: they are needed for nothing else, and the dense founder's lives on them are reading 2's

analysis.unit: founder and signal; a pair is one arm on one founder under one signal, sensory recipe against a sparse recipe
analysis.readings: a frozen copy of each arm at its seam, Brain.reset before each episode: one greedy episode (a clean pass is four stages in four decisions), 100 sampled episodes (success within 10 decisions), first-try accuracy at each stage in sequence
analysis.gate: for each sparse recipe and each arm kind (place, ctx5): sparse minus sensory, paired means pooled over both signals, at least -.05 for the clean greedy pass rate, for sampled success and for first-try accuracy at each of the four stages; a sparse recipe meets this view when all twelve differences meet the margin
analysis.control: The sensory recipe's readings are reading 2's (protocol-cortex-keys-*.json, sensory recipe, the same compose, arms, founders, streams and evaluation; library 88f9d81, whose founder key is byte-identical to the library under test). Before the sparse runs, the sensory recipe is rerun here under the library under test on a declared subset (screen founders 202001 and 202025 on every view, P1 founder 1001, drift founder 1001); every reading and trained-state digest must equal reading 2's, or the sensory recipe is rerun in full before any comparison.
analysis.verdict: a sparse recipe passes the reading when it meets every screen view, P1 and the drift design
analysis.report: as reading 2: paired means with SEM, clean passes as discordant pairs with exact McNemar
